clauses.heading: 1. Definitions
clauses.text:
"Battery Pack" means a set of interconnected portable
electrochemical cells with a rated energy capacity exceeding 2 kWh, designed to be
removable by the end user without the use of tools.

evidence.quote:
"Battery Pack" means a set of interconnected portable
electrochemical cells with a rated energy capacity exceeding 2 kWh, designed to be
removable by the end user without the use of tools.

clauses.heading: 1. Definitions
clauses.text:
"Placing on the Market" means the first making available of a
Battery Pack on the Union market.

evidence.quote:
"Placing on the Market" means the first making available of a
Battery Pack on the Union market.

clauses.heading: 1. Definitions
clauses.text:
"Competent Authority" means the national body designated by a
Member State to monitor compliance with this Regulation, coordinated at Union level
by the European Battery Safety Authority.

evidence.quote:
"Competent Authority" means the national body designated by a
Member State to monitor compliance with this Regulation, coordinated at Union level
by the European Battery Safety Authority.

clauses.heading: 2. Scope
clauses.text:
This Regulation applies to Battery Packs placed on the market within the European
Union on or after the effective date set out in Section 6, including those
incorporated into portable consumer electronics and light electric vehicles.

evidence.quote:
This Regulation applies to Battery Packs placed on the market within the European
Union on or after the effective date set out in Section 6, including those
incorporated into portable consumer electronics and light electric vehicles.

clauses.heading: 3. Obligations
clauses.text:
Manufacturers shall ensure that every Battery Pack placed on the market carries a
label disclosing rated capacity, cell chemistry, and a QR code linking to a digital
safety data sheet, in accordance with the technical requirements of
Regulation (EU) 2023/1542.

evidence.quote:
Manufacturers shall ensure that every Battery Pack placed on the market carries a
label disclosing rated capacity, cell chemistry, and a QR code linking to a digital
safety data sheet, in accordance with the technical requirements of
Regulation (EU) 2023/1542.

clauses.heading: 3. Obligations
clauses.text:
Importers shall verify, before placing a Battery Pack on the market, that the
manufacturer has carried out the applicable conformity assessment procedure and shall
retain supporting documentation for a period of ten years.

evidence.quote:
Importers shall verify, before placing a Battery Pack on the market, that the
manufacturer has carried out the applicable conformity assessment procedure and shall
retain supporting documentation for a period of ten years.

clauses.heading: 3. Obligations
clauses.text:
Distributors shall notify their Competent Authority without undue delay upon
becoming aware that a Battery Pack presents a risk to consumer safety.

evidence.quote:
Distributors shall notify their Competent Authority without undue delay upon
becoming aware that a Battery Pack presents a risk to consumer safety.

clauses.heading: 4. Exemptions
clauses.text:
This Regulation does not apply to Battery Packs that are: incorporated exclusively into medical devices regulated under
Regulation (EU) 2017/745; manufactured solely for export outside the European Union and not placed on the
Union market; supplied in quantities of fewer than 500 units per year by a single manufacturer
for research and development purposes.

evidence.quote:
This Regulation does not apply to Battery Packs that are: incorporated exclusively into medical devices regulated under
Regulation (EU) 2017/745; manufactured solely for export outside the European Union and not placed on the
Union market; supplied in quantities of fewer than 500 units per year by a single manufacturer

clauses.heading: 5. Penalties
clauses.text:
A Competent Authority may impose an administrative fine of up to
€500,000 or 2% of the undertaking's total annual turnover, whichever is higher,
on any manufacturer, importer, or distributor found to be in material non-compliance
with Sections 3 or 4 of this Regulation.

evidence.quote:
A Competent Authority may impose an administrative fine of up to
€500,000 or 2% of the undertaking's total annual turnover, whichever is higher,
on any manufacturer, importer, or distributor found to be in material non-compliance
with Sections 3 or 4 of this Regulation.

clauses.heading: 5. Penalties
clauses.text:
Persistent non-compliance following a first administrative fine may result in
suspension of the undertaking's authorization to place Battery Packs on the market in
the European Union.

evidence.quote:
Persistent non-compliance following a first administrative fine may result in
suspension of the undertaking's authorization to place Battery Packs on the market in
the European Union.

clauses.heading: 6. Effective Date
clauses.text: This Regulation shall enter into force on 1 January 2027.

evidence.quote: This Regulation shall enter into force on 1 January 2027.

clauses.heading: 6. Effective Date
clauses.text:
Undertakings already
placing Battery Packs on the market as of the date of publication shall have until
1 July 2027 to achieve full compliance with the labelling requirements of Section 3.

evidence.quote:
Undertakings already
placing Battery Packs on the market as of the date of publication shall have until
1 July 2027 to achieve full compliance with the labelling requirements of Section 3.
